summary: Mega Man entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Mega Man
entries.definitive_edition: Mega Man Legacy Collection for current access; NES hardware for exact original behavior

emulation.emulator: Mesen / FCEUX only if official route is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use Legacy Collection where possible; document emulator/core and ROM source if used.

primary.why: The first Mega Man is available officially through Mega Man Legacy Collection, which includes the original six NES Mega Man games and museum/challenge extras. Original NES hardware remains the highest historical-fidelity route, while Legacy Collection is the practical current route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Mega Man Legacy Collection on PC or console. Record platform/build, display/filter settings, rewind/save-state/challenge use, controller, input-lag notes, boss order, and whether original NES hardware was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving exact 1987 hardware behavior.
secondary.why: Legacy Collection is convenient, but original NES is the source artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display/filter, save-state/rewind, challenge mode, input lag, and controller.
